clips.title: The story
paras: Red haze cloaks Dreadmist Peak, northwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. The Burning Blade cult keeps a hidden refuge on its crags.

Dreadmist Peak rises above the Barrens, its crags swallowed by a dense red haze that dims the sky. At the crest and in the hollows below, Burning Blade cultists shelter warlocks and toxicologists. They poison nearby water and scheme against the new powers claiming central Kalimdor.
